text:
mira: quick smoke found weird top-1 swaps after converting Gemma->int4, overall cosines similar but rerank top1 wrong a lot.

ken: can you paste the quick numbers?

mira: short run: baseline mean cosine 0.82, converted mean 0.78, hit@1 down ~0.14, hit@5 stable. example: query 'housing policy' -> wrong top1.

olga: sounds like deterministic sign/perm issue (SVD sign normalize or head packing). can you run a small sign-agreement probe?

mira: ran 2k-token probe: sign_agree[:8] -> [0.02,0.97,0.98,0.03,0.96,0.95,0.04,0.94] (dims 0,3,6 inverted).

ken: that indicates sign-diag normalization during SVD folding. workaround: flip those dims and re-eval to confirm.

mira: flipped dims [0,3,6], reran quick smoke -> mean cosine 0.81, hit@1 recovered almost fully.

olga: plan: 1) preserve sign_diag when absorbing SVD factors, 2) add embed-parity regression (seeded token set) to converter CI, 3) audit other exporters for same heuristic.

mira: opening PR with minimal repro and test, blocking gemma/int4 rollout until CI passes.

ci-bot: converter PR pipeline queued (#2376) - tests pending.

ken: thanks team, good quick triage.
